bootstrap.cluster_rule: known preset grouping; unknown presets are singleton clusters

interpretation.meaning: Quality describes the frozen Basic Pitch performance prior; it is not a claim about source audio reconstruction or an OBRUXO training objective.
interpretation.measured: Aggregate values are computed from successful pair results using fixed stock Basic Pitch decoding and no threshold tuning.

pairing.corpus_layout: direct child directory with exact one-to-one extensions

runtime_provenance.interpretation: The existing #25 quality run records a different backend from the fastest observed #24 route. Its quality result remains a CPU-provenance measurement; no XPU full-corpus quality or equivalence claim is made.
runtime_provenance.selection_rationale: The existing #25 run fixed pytorch_cpu in its backend contract; no independent rationale for overriding the faster observed #24 pytorch_xpu route is recorded in the result artifacts.
runtime_provenance.selection_source: the backend contract recorded by the existing #25 run
